title: Chrome Lock policy
description: Chrome reads chrome.storage.managed only for keys declared here, so the parent escrow bundle has to be described before a managed-preferences plist can deliver it. Nothing in this schema is secret: the escrow bundle's private half is sealed under the master password, which is why it is safe to hand to every profile on the machine.

escrowBundle.title: Parent escrow key
escrowBundle.description: The RSA-OAEP key bundle whose private half is sealed under the parent master password. Generate it in the extension's settings page and paste the exported JSON here.
